# Table 1 vendor snapshot

This directory contains the `graphcov` package archived from the author's
repository at commit `8cf757adc4c333dc1427d511f0de2f246d15ebac`.

Table 1 Job 1 and Job 2 verify `official_manifest.json` and import this
package before importing any project-level `graphcov` package. The snapshot
is intentionally separate from the mutable root package used by v11/v12
research experiments.

Do not edit this directory in place. To change the pinned upstream version,
create an explicit reproduction-package commit and regenerate the manifest.
